about: The honesty audit's allowlist (make/check-honesty.mjs). Every place the film's code reads the frame, compares a frame / note / bar / time against a number, names a FORMAT time, or names an ending, must be listed here with the bible's reason; anything else fails. file: a path, a folder ending in /, or *. rule: clock | ending | compare | literal | format | reads | *. detail: a regex on what was found; match: a piece of the line's text (or regex: a regex on it). Every reason starts with its group: FORMAT (bible 9's list), CLOCK (the clock bug, the crank, the wall clock: bible 9 v1.2), GRID (bible 2 definitions and range bounds), RELATIVE (a duration counted from a log-caused event), RANDOM (a hash of seed and frame, bible 1.4), RULING (allowed by the orchestrator's rulings for the final audit: the lid over the last bar, the subtitle fade), AUTHORED (the camera: src/shots.js as a whole), LOADER / LABEL (an ending name that only picks a file or labels it), DRIVER, LAB (drawn only on the lab page), NOT-TIME (a number or name that is not a time). Brought up to date by checker-final, 2026-11-22.
